coverage.coverage: Primary visitor task, coherent audience-appropriate direction, established brand, responsive readability, accessibility and purposeful imagery.
Distinct sections answering visitor questions, meaningful progression and appropriate next action; no repeated pitches or generic filler.
Relevant imagery, examples and demonstrations; composition and interaction serve actual content.
Creative concepts within brief, supplied or verified factual claims, clearly illustrative demos, no fabricated social proof or capabilities.
Presentation depth without unrelated accounts, persistence or integrations; bounded edits and requested frameworks preserved.
Existing identity and audience retained, local-only distinction, appropriate isolated new project, sanitized templates, simple implementation when appropriate.
Necessary dependencies only, one installer with stable inputs, independent asset work, bounded delegation, avoid duplicate uncertain operations.
Focused complete behavior and assets, meaningful metadata, wait for dependencies, preview through existing facilities, revise observed failures.
Proportional checks/build, reuse unchanged evidence, finish prerequisites before delivery, distinguish output from verified behavior.
Actual authorized project workflow, preserve audience/access, resume known pending actions, return verified literal outcome, report verification limits.
